title: Eleven Times Out of Twelve
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：ability　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ability 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother had the ① ability to tell what a child would be good at, and she was right eleven times out of twelve, and she said it was not a gift but arithmetic. The ② ability to do the thing, she said, is the least of it, because everybody can do the thing, and the ability, she said, is not the same as the will.

In 1961 a boy in the village ③ lacked the ability to read a clock, which everybody took for stupidity and she took for something else; she was right, and it was put right in eleven weeks. She did everything ④ to the best of her ability, which is my father's phrase and which she would have hated, because she said the best is not a thing you can measure.

She had a ⑤ natural ability for languages and never learned one, not even the eleven words of Welsh the chapel used, and my mother said that was the tragedy of the street and not of the family. Her ⑥ ability in arithmetic was the thing the county actually paid her for — eleven shillings a week — and she said the money was for the adding up and the rest she gave away, and no ability, she said, survives being unpaid.

The ⑦ abilities she had, several of them, were never written down, nobody in the family has them, and I have stopped looking for them. The ⑧ ability, meaning the mere knack of getting a thing done, is a different matter: eleven people in that street had it, and the ability to be patient was the greatest of them, and all of them are dead.

The  ability I have, and I have exactly one, is to sit still with a problem, and I got it from her, and it is worth less now than it was in 1961. The  ability to see what a child will be good at, which is the one she had, died with her in 1998, and the school has not replaced it, and the county says it is looking.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （把事情办成的）本事；能耐
C. 固定搭配：the ability to do ... 做……的能力
D. 固定搭配：have / lack the ability to do ... 有／没有做……的能力
E. 固定搭配：to the best of one's ability 尽某人所能
F. 固定搭配：ability in ... 在……方面的能力／才能
G. 固定搭配：a natural ability for ... ……的天赋
H. 固定搭配：abilities（多方面的）才能；才干

items.q: My grandmother had the ability to tell
The ability to do the thing, she said
a boy in the village lacked the ability

answers.why: the ability 意为“能力、才能”，祖母有看出一个孩子将来擅长什么的能力，十二次里有十一次是准的。
the ability to do the thing 意为“做这件事的能力”，她说做这件事的能力是最不重要的。
lack the ability to ... 意为“没有做……的能力”，1961 年村里的一个男孩看不懂钟，大家都当他是笨。
to the best of her ability 意为“尽她所能”，她做什么都尽己所能——这是我父亲的说法。
a natural ability for ... 意为“……的天赋”，她在语言上有天赋，却一种语言也没学过。
ability in arithmetic 意为“算术方面的能力／才能”，郡里真正付钱给她的就是她算术上的本事。
abilities 意为“（多方面的）才能、才干”，她身上的那些才能有好几种，从来没有被人记录下来。
the ability 意为“（把事情办成的）本事、能耐”，纯粹指把一件事做成的那种本事。
